coaching.headline: We won zero fights and lost every major objective this game: Fangtooth three times, Genesis Core, Primal Fangtooth.
coaching.team: Three lanes were ours, but the team won none of six decisive fights. The first Fangtooth fell at 10 off an 0-3 teamfight; a 5v4 edge at 17 still lost 0-3. A solo jungle death at 28.8 triggered the collapse: Primal Fangtooth, two inner towers, and the inhibitor followed by 31.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Crunch's solo death at 28.8 came first: Primal Fangtooth, two inner towers, and the inhibitor all fell in the fights right after, with no fight won to stop it.
coaching.whatWorked: Scarlett led the team with 7 kills and 33,233 damage, won the offlane lane all game.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: The jungle matchup favored Crunch late, but the record was 0-8-3 with the most damage taken on the team, 64,807, and the 28.8 solo catch handed Primal Fangtooth and an inner tower to them.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Maco led the team with 21 wards and 13,756 healing, but died first in the match and once more before minute 10 — two early catches is too many for a support.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.text: Two solo catches turned into the Primal Fangtooth and a tower — the costliest night on the roster.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.text: Maco had the best vision on the team, but dying first and once more before 10 gave away the squad's early tempo.

17.call: We had the man advantage, 5-vs-4, at 17m and still lost it 0-3 — that fight needed to be won with the extra body, not just entered with it.

29.3.call: Crunch was already dead when this fight started, 4-vs-5 — don't contest Primal Fangtooth a body down; reset instead.

31.8.call: Scarlett was alive and ahead in lane but never rotated; with Xeebs pinned across the map, this fight should not have been started.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Drongo was on full meta core (Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher, Tainted Rounds) all game — on core, nothing to teach here.

focus.title: Two majors conceded for free
focus.evidence: Fangtooth at minute 22 and Genesis Core at minute 27 both fell with nobody on our side dead — no fight, no contest, just given up.
focus.action: Call the enemy jungle's objective timer and send at least one body to contest every Fangtooth and Core spawn, even without the full group.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.change: Avoid holding solo positions once poked low — two solo catches handed objectives to them tonight.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Mourn Abduct (pull), Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
ourKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
ourKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

ourKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
ourKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the charged Strike; pressure his low survivability

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
ourKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Web Lash root → Crushing Maw armor shred → Hellfire eye → Consume pull-channel
enemyKits.winCondition: root with Web Lash and grind with Hunger-stacked haste
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst on his rooted target
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash — without the root he has no lock-down; interrupt Consume
